notes: Five reusable creative archetypes for RistHome. Each one fixes the hook type, the narrative beats, the format recipe used by scripts/new-post.ts, the platform adaptations, the quality gates and the KPIs to read. Hypotheses are templates: a brief must make them concrete and measurable.

archetypes.name: Process reveal (ingredient to dish)
archetypes.useFor: Cooking classes; any dish with a visible technique (mortar, rolling pasta, frying, filling cannoli).
archetypes.hookType: Hands at work + explicit promise in the first second ('Cook Sicilian pasta with a chef in Palermo').
narrative: 3 to 5 numbered steps from raw to plated

platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: 9:16, 18-25 s, text inside the safe area, cover frame = hook frame.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: same cut; add native captions and a trending sound inside the app; never upload music files you do not own.
platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5, 6-8 slides, one dish per slide, text slide before the CTA.

qualityGates: real RistHome photos only
texts describe what the photo shows
headline >= 84 px, support >= 44 px on 1080 px width
no guest faces without written consent
no price claims unless confirmed by the chef
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: English-speaking travellers in Palermo for 2-4 days, booking experiences on mobile
briefDefaults.objective: Cooking-class bookings on risthome.it or GetYourGuide
briefDefaults.hook: Chef's hands at work + a direct promise
briefDefaults.cta: Book your class on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A step-by-step process reel keeps viewers longer than a plate montage. Success: average watch time >= 60% of length.

archetypes.name: Chef at work (behind the scenes)
archetypes.useFor: Short, fast reels built from action frames: flame, pouring, plating, pasta lifted from the pot.
archetypes.hookType: Action frame with a crash zoom; one short line that names the moment ('3 seconds before service').
narrative: 4-6 fast cuts of the chef working

platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: 9:16, 10-15 s, cuts on the beat if music is added in-app.
platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: not recommended; use a single photo post with the plated result instead.

qualityGates: chef only, or guests with consent
no blurry hook frame
labels optional, keep text under 6 words per scene
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: Food lovers in Sicily and Italian-speaking locals who follow chefs
briefDefaults.hook: The most dynamic frame with a crash zoom
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: Fast behind-the-scenes cuts earn more shares than plated montages. Success: share rate >= 1% of plays.

archetypes.name: Menu list (N things you will eat or cook)
archetypes.useFor: Carousels that name dishes one by one: class menus, event finger food, seasonal menus.
archetypes.hookType: Numbered promise on the cover ('6 finger foods for your event').
narrative: one dish per slide, name + one factual line

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5, 7-9 slides, the cover must work alone in the feed.
platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: optional cut: same slides as 2 s scenes with numbers as labels.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: photo-mode post with the same slides.

qualityGates: every dish name matches the photo
no more than 220 characters per slide body
page indicator on every inner slide
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: People planning an event or a class who compare options and save posts
briefDefaults.hook: A numbered promise over a real tray
briefDefaults.cta: Ask for a proposal on risthome.it
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A list carousel earns more saves than a single photo. Success: save rate >= 2% of reach.

archetypes.name: Private table (place, mise en place, courses)
archetypes.useFor: Private chef at home, villa dinners, boats, events: sell the setting before the food.
archetypes.hookType: The setting first (garden, terrace, laid table) + 'a chef cooks at your place'.

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; the text slide states what is included (shopping, cooking, service, cleanup).
platformAdaptations.tiktok: same cut; captions in English for tourists.

qualityGates: the setting shown is a real RistHome service
courses named only when the photo shows them
the 24-hour quote promise must stay true operationally
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: Couples and families renting villas or apartments around Palermo
briefDefaults.hook: The setting first, then the promise
briefDefaults.cta: Write to us on risthome.it, quote within 24 hours
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: Showing the setting before the plates raises quote requests. Success: >= 2 qualified requests per 1,000 plays.

archetypes.name: Proof and offer (social proof, seasonal offer, gift)
archetypes.useFor: Christmas gift vouchers, seasonal menus, review highlights, milestone posts.
archetypes.hookType: A verified number or quote ('5.0 on Google, 101 reviews') or a dated offer.
narrative: hook: the proof or the offer
CTA with a deadline or a link

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; the proof slide quotes a real review verbatim with the reviewer's first name only.
platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: optional; use when the offer has a deadline.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: rarely; offers convert better on Instagram for this brand.

qualityGates: numbers and quotes verified on the platform the day of posting
offers approved by the chef with price and validity
no AI-generated testimonials
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: Past guests, locals buying gifts, followers who have not booked yet
briefDefaults.hook: A verified number or a dated offer
briefDefaults.cta: Book or buy on risthome.it before the deadline
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A verified proof number in the hook raises link clicks. Success: link CTR >= 1.5% of reach.
